expansion_log.notes: Story 0 created with 58 nonce lemmas (25 nouns, 15 verbs, 12 adjectives, 6 adverbs). All concepts null — meanings to be discovered through future expansion.
First expansion. Brolm discovered as a vast, mutable expanse — a terrain-medium that contains structures but itself transforms.

Sulvek discovered as a verb of emergence/origination. Not movement (melvir) but the transition from non-existence to existence. Takes 'from X' source complement. High reuse rate (96%) — appropriate for a verb-focused story that illustrates the action through existing concepts.
First depth-2 story. Plendrique discovered as a liminal boundary between states of being. 100% reuse — no new words introduced. 9 real English footholds give the reader substantially more traction.
Quelith discovered as the exception to brolm's mutability — the one stable thing in a world of constant change. 100% reuse, 0 new words. DAG links to story_brolm, story_sulvek, story_plendrique.
Grothen discovered as the verb of actualization — bringing latent potential through the plendrique into orniquable being. Climactic verb of Story 0. 100% reuse.

Fenqua discovered as latent, undirected potential — the possibility before the direction. The brolm itself may be a grothened fenqua. Inside quelithen, fenqua is trapped. Depth 2 story with 9 English footholds.

Vrenthane discovered as the manner of unconscious transformation — changing without knowing you're changing. Contrasted with ondrique. The pralune fear it. 7 English footholds including 'blind', 'losing', 'silent'.

Ornique discovered as cognitive apprehension distinct from mere perception (drevith). Two failure modes: morvith (trying and failing) and kethrek (fabricating). The same olvereth can do either. 15 new words introduced.

Pralune discovered as the social class of memory-keepers — the only beings who selmir across jorvunden. The brolm needs them because the brolm cannot ornique itself. 13 new words introduced including selmir/threlven/vossane (collective verbs and gathering).

Savrune discovered at depth 2 as the cognitive gap between drevith and ornique. Every drevith opens its own savrune. Failed crossings leave morvath. The brolm itself may be a savrune. 6 new words introduced.

Morthrene discovered as the collective silence when vrisora reaches its limit. Not absence — vrisora's drilvan into its own savrune. The vossikest pralune teach it is the only true response to the brolm. 6 new words introduced.

Vriso discovered as transmitted/doctrinal knowledge, distinct from ornique (direct apprehension). Vrisoneth can be kelvran (established) or trendrik (contested). The krelquin — the gap between vriso and reality — is the pralune's deepest fear. 14 new words introduced.

FIRST DEPTH-3 STORY. Vossune discovered as the collective state where every pralune shares the same silence at once. The 'voss-' root cluster (vossane, vossik, vossrim, vossune) forms a coherent semantic family of collective depth. 8 new words introduced.

Kelmrith discovered at depth 3 as the effortful labor of crossing a savrune. Typology of kelmriths: drenqar (brief), solthrek (sustained), threndune (lifelong), kelmraith (collective). A pralune with many morvath is vosselik. 6 new words.

FIRST DEPTH-4 STORY. Kelmranix discovered as the porthane's listening posture before a kelmrith. Two kinds (krensil, voldrane), typology of pralune (drevrane = always-in-krensil). 4 new words. 21 English footholds — reader now gets substantial traction.

Felgoren discovered as the ephemeral beings of the brolm — they melvir, kelvirth, leave trendavelen, but do not selmir. At halvorn, the solmire comes. Spectrum: krendavel (unaware) → selvorn (perceptive) → pelvorn (anomalously carrying traces from prior jorvunden). 14 new words.

Brashel discovered as the fundamental verb of effort/contact — pushing against what doesn't move. Every brashel meets a kelvorn (resistance). Can porvrik (break through) or morvulm (bounce back). Selvrathen (marks of brasheling) ARE the kethrim. 12 new words.

Krelquin discovered as the invisible gap between vriso and reality — unlike a voldrek (visible question), a krelquin is a savrune you can't even drevith. Threndavelen hide krelquinen. The morvaineth (self-testing) is feared because kelvornith can break kelvorinen. Solvrenik pralune deny krelquinen exist — the deepest krelquin. 5 new words.
Pralvene at depth 4 — the moment the vossune breaks. The selvrique (first to solvrith) is feared but may be the vossune orniqueing itself. Massive English traction (18 footholds). 4 new words.
Drossik = anything with a krenthane (boundary). drossikath can dissolve (kelvrane). vrendossiken contain other drossiken. The brolm may or may not be the vorelm vrendossik. 8 new words.

Threndavel = a self-concealing belief. Its drelvornith hides its krelquin. Kelvorinen carry threndavelen producing krelthanen. To morvrique = to strip the hiding. A drevquine = the suspicion that something is threndavel. 5 new words.

Morvrique at depth 4 = irreversible breaking of a threndavel's hiding. Requires drelvranique (willingness). Leaves kelvornique (a space, not understanding). Must threndavir afterward. 4 new words. Heavy English traction.

FIRST DEPTH-5 STORY. Krensil = the lightest kelmranix, effortless attention. Krensilath = living in krensil. Drevmorne = to be shaken out of it. 21 English footholds — reader can almost fully parse. 2 new words.

Drilthik = easily-crossed savrune. Key insight: drilthane isn't always intrinsic — kelvrimoring (repeated brasheling) makes savruneren thinner. The kethrim itself is a kelvrimoring. Vrenthavelen make savruneren around them drilthik. 5 new words.

Vorelm = inner density/consequence, not size. Krenthivel = what makes something vorelm. Brenthivelm = inherently vorelm. Selvrimor = falsely vorelm (hollow). The vossikest pralune vriso all drossiken are vorelm. 8 new words.
Selvrique at depth 5 — the one the vossune breaks through. Not chosen — choosing. Drevsolming = sensing it coming. Selvrimath = the weight after. Almost fully English-transparent. 2 new words.

FIRST DEPTH-6 STORY. Krensilath = what remains when you stop trying. A drevsilm — softness of attention. Almost fully English — 22 English footholds in 84 words. Approaching leaf territory. 1 new word.

Morvath = residue of failed kelmriths. Morvathen = accumulated cluster. Drevmorith = still-active morvath. Threndossim = heavy with morvath. Selvrimeth = understanding born from failure, vorelmun than any drilque. 4 new words.
